svg.title: Vulcan salute link cursor, 32x32
svg.desc: Same anatomy as vulcan_salute_32.svg, laid on its side: the hand leans so the two pairs reach up-left and the palm trails to the bottom-right, which is what separates the link pointer from the upright arrow at a glance. Two deltas from the arrow are drawn in, not rotated in: the V is cut deeper into the palm, and the thumb lobe runs longer so the silhouette reads as a hand rather than a wedge. Hotspot is the index fingertip at (6,4) — the leading point of the pair, not the topmost one.
